name: [ CHAPTER 2 ] Winx - The Fairy Guardians
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Winx – The Fairy Guardians! 🧚‍♀️✨


This is a story-driven school roleplay game where you enroll as a Fairy!

Choose Bloom or create your own OC student.
👗 Customize & dress your character with hundreds of options
🏫 Attend classes to get experience & butterflies.
⚔️ Fight creatures and complete boss battles.
🔓 Unlock Stella, Flora, Musa, Tecna, and Aisha by leveling up.

🌈 Unlock Magic Winx & Charmix on each character.
🏠 Explore the campus and roleplay with your friends.
